name: @octocodeai/octocode-benchmark
description: Benchmark suites for Octocode tools and engine behavior.

scripts.build: echo 'Source-only benchmark package; no build artifacts required'
scripts.typecheck: node ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --skipLibCheck --types node tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test: node ../../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.config.ts && python3 -m unittest discover -s compare/bin -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.verify: yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn test
